subject: MdeModulePkg: Add helper to check if FF-A is supported
reasons: Adds a new helper function and declaration rather than transforming existing call sites.
The change is confined to one implementation file and one header with no repeated before/after edit pattern.
Applying it elsewhere would require case-by-case design judgment about where the helper should be used, not a mechanical match-and-replace.
This is API creation, not an API migration or collateral evolution across the codebase.
